translations.clear-quran: ˹They are˺ those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across falsehood, they pass ˹it˺ by with dignity
translations.pickthall: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity

transliterations.easy: Wallazeena laa yash hadoonaz zoora wa izaa marroo billaghwi marroo kiraamaa
transliterations.scholarly: Wa Al-Ladhīna Lā Yash/hadūna Az-Zūra Wa 'Idhā Marrū Bil-Laghwi Marrū Kirāmāan
transliterations.aligned: wa-alladhīna lā yashhadūna l-zūra wa-idhā marrū bil-laghwi marrū kirāman

segments.content: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Ve onlar ki Rablerinin ayetleri hatırlatılınca, kör ve sağır üstüne yıkılıp yatmazlar
translations.diyanet-isleri: Kendilerine Rablerinin ayetleri hatırlatıldığı zaman, onlara karşı kör ve sağır davranmazlar
translations.clear-quran: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it
translations.pickthall: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat

transliterations.easy: Wallazeena izaa zukkiroo bi Aayaati Rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alaihaa summanw wa'umyaanaa
transliterations.scholarly: Wa Al-Ladhīna 'Idhā Dhukkirū Bi'āyāti Rabbihim Lam Yakhirrū `Alayhā Şummāan Wa `Umyānāan
transliterations.aligned: wa-alladhīna idhā dhukkirū biāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ʿalayhā ṣumman waʿum'yānan

segments.content: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Ve onlar ki: «Ey Rabbimiz, lütfunla bizlere eşlerimizden, çocuklarımızdan göz aydınlıkları ihsan buyur ve bizi takva sahiplerine önder kıl!» derler
translations.diyanet-isleri: Onlar: "Rabbimiz! Bize eşlerimizden ve çocuklarımızdan gözümüzün aydınlığı olacak insanlar ihsan et ve bizi, Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakınanlara önder yap" derler
translations.clear-quran: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”
translations.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)

transliterations.easy: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa
transliterations.scholarly: Wa Al-Ladhīna Yaqūlūna Rabbanā Hab Lanā Min 'Azwājinā Wa Dhurrīyātinā Qurrata 'A`yunin Wa Aj`alnā Lilmuttaqīna 'Imāmāan
transliterations.aligned: wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-ij'ʿalnā lil'muttaqīna imāman

segments.content: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَـٰمًا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: İşte hep bunlar, sabretmelerine karşılık cennetin en yüksek makamı ile mükafatlandırılacaklar; orada sağlık ve selam ile karşılanacaklar
translations.diyanet-isleri: İşte onlar, sabrettiklerinden ötürü cennetin en yüksek dereceleriyle mükafatlandırılırlar. Orada esenlik ve dirlik dilekleriyle karşılanırlar
translations.clear-quran: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace
translations.pickthall: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace

transliterations.easy: Ulaaa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatanw wa salaamaa
transliterations.scholarly: Ūlā'ika Yujzawna Al-Ghurfata Bimā Şabarū Wa Yulaqqawna Fīhā Taĥīyatan Wa Salāmāan
transliterations.aligned: ulāika yuj'zawna l-ghur'fata bimā ṣabarū wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyatan wasalāman

segments.content: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Orada ebedi kalacaklar; ne güzel durulacak bir yer, ne güzel bir makam
translations.diyanet-isleri: Orada temellidirler. Orası ne güzel bir yer ve ne güzel duraktır
translations.clear-quran: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside
translations.pickthall: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station

transliterations.easy: Khaalideena feehaa; hasunat mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
transliterations.scholarly: Khālidīna Fīhā Ĥasunat Mustaqarrāan Wa Muqāmāan
transliterations.aligned: khālidīna fīhā ḥasunat mus'taqarran wamuqāman

segments.content: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: De ki: «Duanız olmasa Rabbim size ne kıymet verir?» Demek ki, yalanladılar! O halde yarın ceza (yakalarına) yapışacak
translations.diyanet-isleri: De ki: "İbadetiniz (duanız) olmasa Rabbim size ne diye değer versin?" Ey inkarcılar! Yalanladığınız için, azap yakanızı bırakmayacaktır
translations.clear-quran: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”
translations.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment

transliterations.easy: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum Rabbee law laa du'aaa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
transliterations.scholarly: Qul Mā Ya`ba'u Bikum Rabbī Lawlā Du`ā'uukum Faqad Kadhabtum Fasawfa Yakūnu Lizāmāan
transliterations.aligned: qul mā yaʿba-u bikum rabbī lawlā duʿāukum faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāman
